additional_info.subject: RE: ID0438486-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R2 170001500]Station cannot be open CRM:02698000347
additional_info.body:
Good morning colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0438486,
for an issue to open the front door of the charger.
There are two ways in which the front door can get suck and cannot open anymore:
One of the three locking mechanism is not working. For this case, it means that if you press the black button and you pull the door, you will notice the door getting stuck in one of the 3 points (top, middle, bottom).
There is an issue with the door mechanism associated with the black button. This can occur when the black rubber sheath of the locking cable slips out of its mounting bracket.
Please let me know which one of these cases it is, so that I can provide you guidance on how to open the charger.
If you remember, around one year ago I supported you in a similar case for charger
MP / R1 170001369.
In that case, we had to drill a hole in the metal lock bezel which covers the locking mechanism from inside the charger, accessing the bezel from the back door.
I attach a few pictures to this email, taken from the other case.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0438486-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R2 170001500]Station cannot be open CRM:02698000347
additional_info.body:
Dear Poland Service Team,
Thank you for your feedback.
Regarding the HMI showing a blue screen, it is the first time I am seeing this. May I ask you a few questions about it:
When did it happen?
Was is solved by reboot or other action?
Is it happening periodically, is it permanent or did it happen only once?
At a first glance, I would exclude that replacing the DP cable or updating the DLogic controller could solve the issue, as the DP cable replacement is meant for EMI, while the DLogic FW update is meant to solve dysfunctionalities such has black screen with backlight or distorted images.
At the moment, I see no problem in what the sicharge-cp-frontend is sending to the HMI:
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!
